REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & holding_box) -> u2
(u0, box_fell) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, holding_box) -> u0
(u1, !holding_box) -> u0
(u2, else) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & holding_box, u2) -> 1.0
(u1, holding_box, u0) -> 0.1
feedback: Accepted. Format: all required headers are present; FINAL_STATES is nonempty, declares u2, u2 appears in STATES, and u2 is the accepting condition for this task (finish the walk with the box back in hand). Transitions and rewards follow the required (state, guard) -> state and (state, guard, state) -> reward forms, and both listed rewards attach to declared transitions. Predicate-only guards: only at_exit, holding_box, box_fell with conjunction/negation are used; the task-irrelevant siren_ringing and switch_toggled are absorbed (u0 and u2 via else self-loops, u1 via the complementary holding_box/!holding_box guards, which exhaust the input space so a literal else is unnecessary there). Persistent/event distinction is correct: the event box_fell drives u0->u1, the persistent condition holding_box drives both the pickup bonus and the exit gate, and last-step-only at_exit appears only in the terminal guard. Ordering safety: at_exit&holding_box and box_fell cannot co-occur (box_fell excludes holding_box and at_exit), so u0's guard order is conflict-free. Fidelity: u1 means 'the box fell on the previous step' — (u1, holding_box) fires exactly on the first step after a fall and pays the 0.1 immediacy bonus, while the !holding_box branch pays nothing, so a late pickup earns no bonus, matching the 'your very next move' emphasis. Regression is explicit: each fresh fall re-enters u1, so the second fall is handled; since at most two falls can occur, the bonus can fire at most twice and total reward is bounded (max 1.2), with no farming loop (every 0.1 requires a fresh fall) and no incentive to linger, drop, or avoid the exit. Reachability: the first fall always fires within 2-8 steps and the fall turns the agent to face the box, so an immediate pickup (hence the 0.1) is always achievable, and u2 is reached by exiting while holding the box. Gating the 1.0 exit reward on holding_box is a defensible conjunctive reading: because the fall is guaranteed, an empty-handed exit means the re-pickup directive was disregarded; note there is no reachable (u1, at_exit & holding_box) case — a pickup immediately leaves u1 and pickup and exit cannot share a step — so the absence of a u1->u2 exit edge loses nothing.
